title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Jilla Sahakari Kendriya Bank Maryadit, Shajapur, Madhya Pradesh
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBl) has, by an order dated July 21, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹1 lakh (Rupees One Lakh only) on Jilla Sahakari Kendriya Bank Maryadit, Shajapur, Madhya Pradesh (the bank), for contravention of the provisions of section 26A read with section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 (BR Act).
